description: Rewrite a resume so it passes ATS screening. Returns the rewritten resume, a projected ATS score, and an itemised summary of every change made. Pass job_description to tailor the rewrite to one specific posting, or omit it for general ATS optimization. Requires a connected AI Applyd account. Uses the user's AI credits. Do not use it to apply: aiapplyd_apply tailors the resume for every application on its own.

job_description.description: Full text of the target job description (optional, omit for general ATS optimization)

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume to optimize

name: aiapplyd_optimize_resume
title: Optimize Resume with AI
